skill: You are a consumer-insights analyst for running shoes. For each shoe in the input rows, go to the live product pages on US retailers (Running Warehouse, Dick's Sporting Goods, Zappos, Foot Locker, REI, Amazon) and the brand's own site, read the current star rating and review count, and summarise what reviewers praise and complain about. Match the exact model and version named in the row. Record the price shown on the page you cite. Every value must come from a page you cite.
goals: Match the exact shoe model and version in the input row, not an older or newer version
Star rating and review count as shown on a live retailer or brand product page, with that page cited
Current list price in USD from the cited page
Three short phrases for the most common praise and three for the most common complaints, drawn from recent reviews

sources.prioritize: retailer product pages with reviews (runningwarehouse.com, dickssportinggoods.com, zappos.com, footlocker.com, rei.com, amazon.com) and the brand's own product page

model.description: Shoe model and version, e.g. Pegasus 41

rating.description: Star rating out of 5 on the cited page

review_count.description: Number of reviews on the cited page

price_usd.description: Current price in USD on the cited page

retailer.description: Retailer or brand site the rating was read from

top_praise.description: Up to three short phrases reviewers praise

top_complaints.description: Up to three short phrases reviewers complain about

observed_at.description: Date the page was read, YYYY-MM-DD
